explanation: The proof applies the library's own lemma TauCeti.isSimpleRing_moduleEnd_of_isIsotypic, which is not in Mathlib. Its only Mathlib input is IsSimpleRing.isIsotypic. Searches: grep across Mathlib for `isSimpleRing_moduleEnd`, `IsSimpleRing (Module.End`, any `IsSimpleRing` statement mentioning `End`, and all `isSimpleRing` lemma names; also read RingTheory/SimpleModule/WedderburnArtin.lean and the RingTheory/SimpleRing/ files. Closest results: IsSemisimpleRing.moduleEnd (gives only semisimplicity), IsSimpleRing.matrix (matrix rings over a simple ring are simple) and the Wedderburn–Artin decompositions. Deriving simplicity of End R M from these needs a real argument (showing End R M is a single matrix ring), not a one-line instantiation.
